item.text: I’ll trace the v27 movement decode path and its tests, then patch the signed rounding behavior and run the focused test suite.

The bug is isolated: the decoder converts through `float` and `Math.round`, which can make negative fractional block positions more negative. I’m changing the fixed-point conversion to Java integer division (truncation toward zero) and adding boundary tests around zero and negative block edges.
